voyage.content: An interactive museum devoted to the history and culture of video games. Its exhibitions cover the development of games in Korea and abroad, game characters and music, and the cultural value of gaming. Visitors can also browse game-related materials and play classic arcade, console, and PC games.

voyage.name: Tomb of Jeongseon Princess
voyage.content: A historic burial site associated with Jeongseon Princess, the seventh daughter of King Seonjo of the Joseon Dynasty. The site includes the graves of the princess, her husband Kwon Dae-im, and other members of the Andong Kwon clan. Its tombstones and epitaphs are valuable sources for understanding Joseon-period funerary practices.

voyage.name: Ankara Park
voyage.content: A small park created to commemorate the sister-city relationship between Seoul and Ankara, the capital of Turkey. Opened in 1977, the park includes Ankara House, a traditional Turkish-style building, as well as sculptures and landscaped areas representing the friendship between the two cities.

voyage.name: Centre Pompidou Hanwha
voyage.hours: Tu Th F Su 10:00-18:00, W Sa 10:00-21:00; closed M
voyage.content: A modern and contemporary art museum operated through a partnership between the Centre Pompidou in Paris and the Hanwha Foundation of Culture. It opened in 2026 and presents exhibitions drawn from the Centre Pompidou collection as well as contemporary art programs. Check the current exhibition schedule before visiting, as galleries may close between exhibitions.

voyage.name: Seonyudo Park
voyage.content: This is a park with many gardens in the island of Seonyudo. The island was a site of water purification plant until 2000, and was converted to a park in 2002. Many of the sculptures and architectures are remnants of the previous plant, and won many awards such as Korean Architecture Institute Award and American Society of Landscape Architects Award. It is now a nice photo spot used by Seoul citizens. English pamphlet

voyage.name: Yeouido Park
voyage.content: Enormous and hugely popular park. This site was an airfield until 1971, and was used as Seoul's main airport before Gimpo Airport. There is a traditional Korean forest, and in many other places you can enjoy concerts, cycling, or taking walks. Hundreds of trees and flowers offer you shade and an opportunity to relax. There are nice ponds and basketball courts. For a nominal fee, one can also rent bicycles or roller b

voyage.name: Yeouido Hangang Park
voyage.content: One of Seoul's most popular riverside parks, with wide lawns and views of the Han River. It is popular for picnics, walking, and cycling, and bicycles can be rented nearby. The park is also a popular place to watch the sunset and hosts seasonal events, including the Seoul International Fireworks Festival. It is a good place to experience how Seoul residents spend their leisure time along the Han River.

voyage.name: Geobugi Upyeonso
voyage.content: Inspired by the slow, deliberate pace of a turtle, it offers a peaceful sanctuary where visitors can write "slow letters" that are delivered one year later and enjoy quiet moments.

voyage.name: SEOULDAL
voyage.price: Adults ₩25,000, teens and seniors ₩20,000, children age 3-12 ₩15,000
voyage.hours: Tu-Th Su 12:00-22:00, F Sa 12:00-23:00 (Aug-Oct); closed M. Weather dependent
voyage.content: A tethered helium balloon that rises up to 130 m above Yeouido Park, offering panoramic views of the Han River and Seoul skyline. Each flight lasts about 15 minutes.

voyage.name: Gocheok Sky Dome
voyage.content: South Korea's first domed baseball stadium and the home stadium of the Kiwoom Heroes. It also hosts concerts, awards ceremonies, and other large-scale events. Public transportation is recommended because traffic and parking can be crowded on event days.

voyage.name: Pureun Arboretum
voyage.content: Seoul's first public arboretum, with themed gardens, wetlands, walking paths, a forest education center, and thousands of plant species. It is a quiet place for walking and nature viewing in southwestern Seoul.

voyage.name: Guro Arts Valley Theater
voyage.content: A cultural arts complex with a 579-seat theater, gallery, small hall, education rooms, and other facilities. It hosts concerts, theater performances, exhibitions, and cultural programs throughout the year.

voyage.name: D-Cube Link Arts Center
voyage.content: A large musical theater inside D-Cube City with 1,242 seats. It hosts major Korean productions of musicals and other stage performances, and is directly connected to Sindorim Station.

voyage.name: Hangdong Railroad
voyage.content: A former freight railway that has become a popular walking route and photo spot. The single-track railway runs through a quiet green area and connects naturally with Pureun Arboretum, making it a pleasant place for a short walk.

voyage.name: Anyangcheon Stream Walkway
voyage.content: A riverside walking and cycling route known for cherry blossoms in spring. The stream supports a variety of birds, fish, and plants, and the riverside also has recreational and sports areas. The Guro section is easily accessible from several subway stations.

voyage.name: Guro Ollegil
voyage.content: A network of nine walking routes totaling 28.5 km across Guro-gu. The routes include forest trails through local hills, riverside paths along streams such as Anyangcheon, and urban walking routes. Visitors can choose individual sections rather than completing the entire trail.

voyage.name: Yeongdeungpo Park
voyage.content: A neighborhood park built on the former site of an OB beer factory. One of its landmarks is a large copper brewing kettle that was actually used in beer production in the 1930s. The park also has lawns, a pond, sports courts, and other recreational facilities.

voyage.name: Seoul Marina Club & Yacht
voyage.hours: Daily 10:00-22:00; closed on Seollal and Chuseok
voyage.content: A marina on the Han River offering yacht rides and sailing experiences with views of the Seoul skyline. Professional crews operate the yachts, and evening rides are popular for views of the city lights along the river.

voyage.name: E-Land Cruise – Yeouido Dock
voyage.hours: Daily 11:00-22:00; departure times vary by cruise
voyage.content: Sightseeing cruises departing from Yeouido on the Han River. Programs include daytime sightseeing, sunset, night, music, and dinner cruises, with routes offering views of Seoul's riverside skyline and bridges. Passengers should check the current schedule before visiting, and adults should bring identification.

voyage.name: Gocheok Neighborhood Park
voyage.content: One of Guro-gu's main neighborhood parks, with wooded walking paths, murals, sports facilities, and open recreation areas. It is a quiet place for a walk or light exercise away from the busier commercial areas of the district.

voyage.name: YDP CULTURAL LOUNGE DADADA
voyage.content: A public cultural lounge in the Times Square plaza offering exhibitions, workshops, media art, and community programs. The space works with local artists and residents and can also be used as a place to rest while exploring the Yeongdeungpo area.

voyage.name: Gungdong Reservoir Ecological Park
voyage.content: An ecological park built around a former reservoir, with walking trails, traditional Korean pavilions, exercise equipment, an outdoor stage, and areas for observing plants and wildlife. More than 25,000 plants grow around the reservoir, which is also home to around 100 koi fish.

voyage.name: Cheonwangsan Family Camping Site
voyage.content: A family-oriented campground near Cheonwangsan Mountain and Pureun Arboretum. It has regular and automobile camping sites, shower facilities, washing areas, and equipment rentals. Reservations are required, and the surrounding trails provide easy access to nearby green spaces.

voyage.name: Yeouinaru Station Runner Station
voyage.content: A facility for runners inside Yeouinaru Station, designed as a base for running along the Han River. It has changing rooms, lockers, powder rooms, shoe sanitizers, an InBody analyzer, and information on running routes and events. Running classes and other programs are also offered.

voyage.name: Culture Train 959
voyage.price: Exhibitions are generally free; classes and programs may charge a fee
voyage.hours: Varies by exhibition, class, and program
voyage.content: A cultural arts space built inside Sindorim Station. It includes an art platform, gallery, and classrooms, and hosts exhibitions by resident artists as well as drawing, painting, photography, craft, and other cultural programs. Check the current program schedule before visiting.

voyage.name: Yeouiseo-ro (Yunjung-ro) Cherry Blossom Road
voyage.hours: Open year-round; cherry blossom season is usually in early April
voyage.content: A riverside road behind the National Assembly that is one of Seoul's best-known cherry blossom walking routes. In spring, the road is lined with cherry trees, azaleas, forsythias, and other flowers, and it hosts the annual Yeongdeungpo Yeouido Spring Flower Festival.

voyage.name: Techno Mart (Sindorim)
voyage.content: The Techno Marts at Sindorim station.There are two Techno Marts in Seoul: the original at Gangbyeon station, and the new store at Sindorim station. Both complexes house over 2,000 stores across eight floors that sell a variety of high-tech products. Restaurants, a cinema and an arcade are on floors 9 & 10.

voyage.name: Times Square
voyage.content: Yeongdeungpo Times Square is a new UELC-Urban Entertainment Lifestyle Center. It consists of more than 200 commercial, business, cultural, and leisure spaces, including department stores, various shopping brands, bookstores, and aquariums.

voyage.name: The Hyundai Seoul
voyage.content: A large modern department store in the Parc.1 complex, known for its spacious interior, indoor garden, waterfall, fashion and lifestyle shops, restaurants, and frequently changing pop-up stores.

voyage.name: No Brand Supermarket
voyage.content: No Brand is a chain supermarket in Seoul. It is Korea's equivalent of Aldi, except every single product has the same yellow "no brand" labelling. Their products are excellent quality and some are quite unusual. Recommended for self-catering or for snacks.

voyage.name: Jinju-house
voyage.content: It is a famous restaurant for Korean traditional food, Kongguksu. Inside the Yeouido Department Store.

voyage.name: Feel Damn Good Bakery
voyage.content: Unassuming bakery with a plethora of self-serve baked goods, coffee and fresh sandwiches made to order. English spoken.

voyage.name: 김밥처럼 선유도역 본점
voyage.price: 10,000 Won for a few dishes to share
voyage.content: Great local snack bar. No English sign but cheap, delicious Korean food. Friendly staff. Order via touchpad at table.

voyage.name: JinJin's Dumpling
voyage.price: Around ₩89,000 for eobokjaengban; cheaper dumpling dishes are also available
voyage.content: A Korean restaurant specializing in handmade dumplings, dumpling soup, and eobokjaengban, a traditional platter of boiled beef and vegetables.

voyage.name: Jeongin Myeonok
voyage.content: A long-running restaurant specializing in Pyeongyang-style naengmyeon, known for its mild beef broth and buckwheat noodles. Dumplings, boiled beef, and eobokjaengban are also available.

voyage.name: Itama-e
voyage.content: A 15-year-old Yeouido Japanese izakaya restaurant with authentic Japanese cuisine and side dishes based on raw fish aged with fresh sashimi

voyage.name: Ijo Handmade Kalguksu
voyage.content: A 37-year-old soybean noodle restaurant, its signature menu includes soybean noodles made using Korean frosted beans and handmade king dumplings. It features a rich and savory soup and chewy noodles. Also, it is served with homemade kimchi and dongchimi to create a well-balanced taste.

voyage.name: Grandma Pie
voyage.content: Located in Sindorim Station, the restaurant specializes in American-style pizza by the slice and focaccia. The dough is of high quality and the texture is impressive, and a variety of sauces and drinks that go with pizza are also gaining popularity. The interior of the store is decorated with a hip atmosphere that feels American.

voyage.name: Masgihaeng four seasons Dangsan Branch
voyage.content: Located near Dangsan Station, the store specializes in seasonal dishes, especially Hamo shabu-shabu and clam shabu-shabu. Inside, it is spacious and offers private meals. In front of the store, there is an aquarium where you can check out fresh seafood yourself. In addition, braised pollack stew and raw octopus, served as basic side dishes, are also well received by many visitors.

voyage.name: 103 Modern Chinese Food
voyage.content: As a bar serving fusion Chinese cuisine, it is an attractive place with a wide variety of menus and ambiance. In particular, signature yukhoe boasts a unique combination, served with avocado, chasai, and sriracha sauces. The interior is spacious and has many tables, making it suitable for group visits.

voyage.name: Dangsan Red Jjukkumi
voyage.content: Known for its spicy webfoot octopus dishes, it is a restaurant that offers a wide variety of webfoot octopus menus. It is a perfect atmosphere for dinners or gatherings with friends, and the unique sauce combination using boiled eggs and tartare sauce served as a standard table setting is attractive. Fried rice is recommended as a must-have, and it can be enjoyed deliciously as it is well infused with spicy seasoning

voyage.name: Hanmaum Meat Restaurant
voyage.address: 1F, 63 Dosin-ro, Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul, 07366, Rep. of KOREA
voyage.content: Hanmaum Meat Restaurant serves a wide variety of pork and beef dishes. You can grill fresh, high-quality meats right at your table and enjoy them with a diverse selection of side dishes that bring out the absolute best flavors.With spacious seating designed to comfortably accommodate large groups, it is an ideal spot for family gatherings.

voyage.name: GOATT DELICATESSEN
voyage.address: 2F, 14, Dorim-ro 139-gil, Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea
voyage.content: Goat Deli Mullae is a cozy house-cured meat deli hidden on the second floor of a vintage alley building in Mullae-dong.The restaurant pairs warm wooden interiors and a classic European vibe with an artisanal selection of pastrami and jambon.Visitors can enjoy exceptional handcrafted sandwiches like the signature Jambon Beurre alongside highballs, craft beers, or coffee.

voyage.name: Dahee
voyage.content: This is the oldest Korean cocktail bar and there is the oldest Korean bartender. You can enjoy all over 20 cocktails for just ₩5,000.

voyage.name: reidio

voyage.address: Room 106 on the 1st floor of 101, Gyeongin-ro 47-gil, Guro-gu

Shinjeon Tteokbokki. There is Radio Gocheok Sky Dome near Saemaul Geumgo. Enter the Radio Gocheok Sky Dome through the T map or Naver map navigation, and you can come easily and quickly. Use the Gocheok 1-dong Village Public Parking Lot.

voyage.content: It is a traditional handmade skewer dish baked over charcoal.You can enjoy 25 centimeters long skewer food. There are a total of 66 kinds of skewers.

voyage.name: Home and Bread
voyage.content: A small bakery offering a variety of breads. One of its popular items is the Chocolat Cashew Nut, made with chocolate and nuts.

voyage.name: Chiraendopeu Coffee Bar
voyage.content: Located in Dangsan Station, the cafe features LP music and sensuous interior design. Serving a wide range of drinks and desserts, croffles and signature coffees are especially popular. The atmosphere is good and suitable for working alone, and it is also suitable for dates and gatherings with friends.

voyage.name: MAKON
voyage.content: It is a cafe with western American sensibility, and the combination of wood-tone interior and subtle lighting creates a cozy atmosphere. It offers a variety of desserts and coffee menus, especially the Aubero, a black sesame latte, is famous for its signature menu. Located in a quiet alley, it is the perfect place to work alone or talk to friends.

voyage.name: FB Coffee Rosters
voyage.content: With a quiet and cozy atmosphere, it provides a good place to concentrate. You can enjoy roasted coffee and various desserts, especially salt bread and egg tarts. The interior of the cafe is industrial and comfortable, making it a perfect environment for working alone.

voyage.name: Bae Bae Coffee Rosters
voyage.content: This is a cafe that roasts green beans, a special-class single origin from the representative coffee shop.

voyage.name: Waba
voyage.content: A long-running beer chain popular for affordable drinks and group gatherings. Lively in the evenings, especially near Yeongdeungpo Station.

voyage.name: HanshinPocha
voyage.content: Classic Korean pocha-style bar serving spicy chicken feet and simple drinking food. Loud, casual, and popular late into the night.

voyage.name: Yeokgeonhalmoenimeakju
voyage.content: Budget-friendly beer bar chain with retro decor. Very popular with students and younger crowds.

voyage.name: Izakaya Wugyu
voyage.content: Japanese-style izakaya serving skewers, sashimi, and sake. Popular for smaller groups and quieter evenings.

voyage.name: Yukhoebarunyeonao
voyage.content: A casual bar-restaurant focused on raw beef and salmon dishes. Common choice for dinner-drinks combinations.

voyage.name: Cafe Obom
voyage.content: Located on the second floor of a building along Dorim-ro in Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul, this is a cozy local neighborhood café with a quiet atmosphere.It offers a selection of coffee, tea, beverages, and desserts, providing a comfortable space suitable for quiet conversations or individual work.

voyage.name: Eastwood Dorim
voyage.content: The café offers a diverse selection of freshly baked financiers and pastries, alongside filter coffee and customizable milk options. Situated in a compact neighborhood space, seating is limited and dedicated parking is unavailable, so popular baked items may sell out early in the day.

voyage.name: Cafe Arte
voyage.content: Located on Saemallo 16-gil in Guro-gu, Seoul, serving as a quiet local cafe space in the neighborhood. It provides a cozy and accessible indoor environment for visitors looking to grab a casual drink. The venue offers a comfortable spot to rest or meet locally away from the main commercial streets.

voyage.name: Hotel Loft
voyage.content: A quiet hotel with large, well-appointed rooms for a good price. Free laundry service if staying longer than 2 nights.

voyage.name: Anuk Hotel Yeongdeungpo
voyage.address: 10, Yeongjung-ro 10-gil, Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea
voyage.content: Anuk Hotel Yeongdeungpo is a stylish and comfortable boutique hotel located in a vibrant area of Yeongdeungpo, Seoul. It offers modern, cozy rooms designed for relaxation, making it a great base for travelers and couples. Conveniently situated near local dining spots and public transit, it provides a quiet and private retreat in the city.

voyage.name: Olympic Park
voyage.content: Built for the 1986 Asian Games and the 1988 Seoul Olympics. A lake, a large field covered with the grass, and a square with sculptures are very popular among visitors. It is frequently visited by brides and grooms to take their wedding pictures. There are a couple of courses that are ideal for jogging or walking. In addition, the outdoor stage and the six stadiums are often used for concerts and other special events.

voyage.name: Iljasan Park
voyage.content: Park with sports facilities, many herb gardens and an astronomical observatory.

voyage.name: Seokchon Lake
voyage.content: Actually two lakes divided by a road, surrounded by park with several playgrounds. This park is something of an oasis in the middle of the skyscraper landscape. There is also a bar inside Seokchon Lake, so you can enjoy beer with the lake in the background.

voyage.name: Lotte World Tower
voyage.content: Enjoy the view from the fifth tallest building in the world. Be sure to check the weather before entry. The Lotte World Tower is a 555.7-metre (1,823 ft), 123-story skyscraper located in Sincheon-dong, Songpa District. It opened to the public in 2017, and is the tallest building in South Korea and the sixth tallest in the world.

voyage.name: Seoulchakbogo
voyage.content: It is also a place where used books are collected and various cultural performances are held. There is also a cafe. It also has huge amounts of used books donated and sold and operated by the Seoul Metropolitan Government. If you like books, this place is recommended.

voyage.name: Songlidan load
voyage.content: A hot place for young people these days. There are so many delicious restaurants and pretty cafes here. There are also many hidden cafes all over the place.

voyage.name: Lotte World Aquarium
voyage.address: 300 Lotte World Mall B1 to the Olympic Games
voyage.content: The Lotte World Aquarium, which created the closest environment to nature for "Another Sea" sea friends who recreated the marine ecosystem of the five oceans around the world, is harmonized with ocean friends from all over the world. You can experience the aquarium directly and learn the importance of the sea while feeling it.

voyage.name: 291 photographs
voyage.content: This place is inside Lotte Tower Mall and various photos of photographers are hung. There are 500 pictures and you can buy the pictures you want.

voyage.name: Seoul Baekje Museum.
voyage.content: Seoul Baekje Museum (Korean: 한성백제박물관) is a museum in South Korea. Based on the natural silhouette of the nearby Mongchontoseong, the appearance of Seoul Baekje Museum was shaped a ship of Baekje in honor of Baekje. Seoul Baekje Museum is a civic lifelong education center with an emphasis on the educational role. There are a variety of Baekje artifacts and vividly embodied materials on ancient history of the Korean pe

voyage.name: Songpa Book Museum
voyage.content: Songpa Book Museum is the first public book museum in the country. The design of the building was created with the motif of the layers of a bookshelf. The first floor consists of a reading space, a book experience exhibition room, and a cafe. The second floor consists of a digital content experience space, a creative space, and an outdoor space for reading. Lectures or educational programs are also held in the open s

voyage.name: SOMA Museum of Art
voyage.content: SOMA Museum of Art opened in 2004, and has become Songpa's representative art museum. It exhibits various paintings and outdoor sculptures, and regularly hosts special exhibitions on various themes.

voyage.name: Jamsil Sports Complex
voyage.content: This large sports complex centered around Jamsil Olympic Stadium, built in 1976 and host to most of the competitions in the 1988 Seoul Olympics. Though its heady Olympic heydays are long past, this sports complex is still very much active and frequently hosts various cultural and sporting events, most frequently concerts and baseball games. At Jamsil Baseball Stadium, Doosan Bears and LG Twins are home to this arena.

However, what it is most famous for is one of the world's largest indoor theme park. Lots of rides. It's a great way to feel the atmosphere of Lotte World in a short time and at a reasonable price. There are many good restaurants around here, so you can enjoy delicious food after enjoying the ice rink. Resurfacing times: daily 12:50-13:10, 14:00-14:30, 16:00-16:30, 17:30-18:00, and 20:00-20

voyage.name: Garak Market
voyage.content: This is an enormous farmers' and fish market. It is a good place to visit because the amenities are well-equipped.

voyage.name: Garden5
voyage.content: This is a large, very new mall and shopping complex that is part of the district government's efforts to make Songpa more of a center of culture and commerce. This complex is somewhat of a hybrid, selling both consumer goods and acting as a distribution center for manufacturers and wholesalers.

voyage.name: Lotte Department Store
voyage.content: Part of the above-mentioned complex that includes Lotte World, the Lotte Department Store here is a standard Korean Department Store - except, of course, all the other attractions attached to it.

voyage.name: Olympic-ro
voyage.content: The stretch of road from the sports complex to Lotte World has a fair number of stores and cafes here, and they're open quite late because of the nearby Sincheon nightlife area (see below). Nothing special, you'll find the typical clothing and gadget stores you find everywhere else.

voyage.name: Lotte World Mall
voyage.content: Lotte World Mall is located in Lotte Tower. Compared to Lotte Department Store next door, Lotte World Mall has a more youth-oriented fashion space. If you want to see the youthful atmosphere of Korea indoors, visit Lotte World Mall.

voyage.name: Viking Sweep
voyage.content: This is a buffet of unlimited food, especially lobster. It is expensive.

voyage.name: Ashley Queens

voyage.name: Gordon Ramseyburger

voyage.content: The first Gordon Ramsay burger in Asia. Enjoy a high-end concept burger restaurant from world-renowned 3 Michelin-starred chef Gordon Ramsay.

voyage.name: Chunghwaog
voyage.content: This restaurant serves kukbap, a national dish of Korea. It's one of the most delicious restaurants in Korea. You can control the spiciness with the red seasoning called dadaegi.

voyage.name: Bangeog
voyage.content: This is the place to go for Korean-style barbecue. Along with the meat, you can also enjoy "so-mac," a mixture of Korean soju and beer.

voyage.name: obut restaurant

voyage.content: A cozy Western-style bistro in Wirye New Town with a warm, inviting atmosphere. It is local favorite for its succulent steaks and flavorful pasta dishes, offering a perfect setting for a relaxed meal.

voyage.name: jejugan
voyage.content: A Jeju-inspired BBQ spot specializing in premium aged pork belly. The staff grills the meat at your table, allowing for a perfectly cooked, hassle-free dining experience.

voyage.content: It is a five-star hotel with perfect facilities around it and the station is also near.The price is a little expensive.

voyage.name: Dellight hotel (딜라이트호텔)
voyage.content: It's a reasonable price for a night's sleep. There is Seokchon Lake nearby.

voyage.name: Hotel Lake
voyage.content: Hotel Lake is 11 minutes' walk from Seokchon Station Exit 8 of Subway Line 8. Seokchon Lake, a downtown rest stop, is across from the hotel, and Lotte World Tower, the 6th highest place in the world, is 15 minutes away on foot.

Staff at Signiel Seoul can assist guests with luggage storage, valet parking and concierge services. Dry cleaning, laundry, trouser press and ironing services are available at a surcharge.

voyage.name: Hotel the Castle Banyi
voyage.content: The rooms in the hotel are equipped with an electric tea pot. Featuring a private bathroom with a bidet. At the accommodation rooms include air conditioning and a flat-screen TV.

voyage.name: April 19t National Memorial Cemetery
voyage.content: Dedicated to the tragic events in 1960 which are now considered the roots of modern Korean democracy. 224 people were killed during the April 19 Movement, and were buried in this cemetery. It became a national cemetery in 1995. This place has a museum, several statues, and a mausoleum. It is a popular park to learn about culture and heritage.

voyage.name: Dream Forest Park
voyage.content: Dream Forest, one of the largest parks in northern Seoul, spans 660,000 square meters and features various attractions, including a lake, art galleries, and an observatory offering panoramic views of the city and surrounding mountains. The park was built on the former site of Dreamland, an amusement park, and is designed to provide a blend of natural and cultural spaces for visitors. Its highlights include the Wolgwa

voyage.name: Korea Furniture Museum
voyage.content: 2,000 pieces of traditional furniture and ten traditional Korean houses on display. Visits by guided tour only, which has to be booked beforehand. You can get there by bus 02 after getting off at Hansung University Station using Line 4.

voyage.name: Dooly Museum
voyage.content: It is a museum that exhibits Korean famous cartoon Dooly.

voyage.name: Nowon Mathematics Culture Center
voyage.content: Nowon Mathematics Culture Center is an experience-oriented cultural center, and has a variety of contents to help you easily and enjoy math away from problem-solving math learning.

voyage.name: Kimsuyoung Literary Museum
voyage.content: It was built in Dobong-gu, the former residence of Korean poet Kim Suyoung, and contains his main house, tomb, and monument. The Dobong Public Literary Center was established by the Dobong District Office in Seoul to honor the legacy of poet Kim Soo-young, who lived and worked in the area. voyage.content: It is a modern hanok village. There are Bukhansan Mountain and Jingwansa Temple near the hanok village. Since it is a private area where residents live, noise activities should be refrained from during the night after sunset.

voyage.name: Korean Stone Museum
voyage.content: It is a museum of stone artifacts from South Korea. It displays historical relics and sculptures related to stones.

voyage.name: Bukhansan
voyage.content: The highest peak in Seoul, at 836.5 m. Close to the summit, standing above Seoul, is one of the starkest nature/urban divides in the world. These hiking trails are the most visited of the world, with friendly local hikers.

voyage.name: Surak San
voyage.content: This is a mountain that connects Dobongsan Mountain and Bukhansan Mountain. If you want a simple climb, it's the right one.

voyage.name: Dobongsan
voyage.content: This is a stone mountain. Many professional hikers visit the mountain and it is quite famous among the mountains of Korea.

voyage.name: Jungrangcheon
voyage.content: The stream is connected from Uijeongbu to the Han River and is connected to other areas in the middle. There are bicycle roads and exercise equipment. There are also many life and plants. The scenery is lovely.

voyage.name: BuramSan
voyage.content: The mountain is monotonous, but the combination of huge rock walls, cliffs, and lush trees gives it a beautiful scenery. There are many people who visit to see the sunrise as well.

voyage.name: Seongbuk cheon
voyage.content: It is a small river in Seongbuk-gu. It is a good place to take a walk along the river or to spend time with small cafes around the river.

voyage.name: VIC market
voyage.address: Lotte Mart Dobong Branch 645 in Dobong-gu
voyage.content: VIC Market is similar to Costco. It can be purchased cheaply on a membership basis.

voyage.name: Lotte Department Store Nowon Branch
voyage.address: Lotte Department Store Nowon Branch 1414 Dongil-gu
voyage.content: It is a department store with movie theaters and restaurants.

voyage.name: Suyu market
voyage.content: The Suyu market is a traditional market. Inside, they sell various food ingredients and snacks. They sell not only food but also clothes.

voyage.name: 2001 Outlet
voyage.content: Fashion, furniture, and Kim's Club.

voyage.name: Homeplus
voyage.hours: Daily 10:00-24:00 (closed regularly on the 2nd and 4th Sun)

voyage.name: Traders' Wholesale Club Wolgye Branch
voyage.content: It is a warehouse-type mart, so you can buy various Korean ingredients cheaply.

voyage.name: Hyundai Department Store Mia Branch
voyage.content: It is a department store in Mia-dong. You can shop various brands of products.

voyage.name: Suyeon Sanbang
voyage.content: A tea house located in an old traditional wooden house which used to be the home of the writer Lee Tae-Jun. Try the jujube (red dates) tea and the pumpkin desserts while admiring the picturesque garden. There are only very few tables available, so it pays off to come early to get one of the good tables at the window. This place is quite expensive and having a tea for two with dessert will cost you around ₩20,000.

voyage.name: Foodieshill
voyage.content: This is a buffet. Japanese food, Chinese food, Korean food, dessert, and so on. You'd better make a reservation because there are many waiting guests.

voyage.name: May dining
voyage.content: The restaurant needs to go deeper into view. This place looks like a very fine restaurant. There is a garden and a nice building and you can eat course food. The feel can be shared.

voyage.name: Musuok
voyage.content: It is a representative restaurant in Dobong-gu. It was introduced very much on TV. Seolleongtang is a good restaurant. Seolleongtang is a Korean traditional food. Suggest.

voyage.name: Matsumura Tonkatsu Main Store
voyage.content: It's a pork cutlet restaurant. Word of mouth, second and third stores have sprung up. Handmade pork cutlet and the amount for one day is fixed.

voyage.name: Little Bangkok
voyage.content: It is a place where you can eat Thai food such as Pad Thai.

voyage.name: Bubu Shef
voyage.content: It is a place where Italian food is sold, and you can enjoy a variety of Italian food at a low price.

voyage.name: Hansungdoe
voyage.content: It is a meat restaurant in a small stream in Seongbuk-gu. Pork is sold, and you can eat outside when the weather is nice

voyage.name: Gupo Noodle
voyage.content: It is a restaurant that sells Korean food such as banquet noodles, bossam, jeon, and samhap.

voyage.name: Suragio Naengmyeon
voyage.content: It is a 21-year-old naengmyeon specialty restaurant that boasts a clean and cool taste using water-based broth. Along with a variety of naengmyeon menus, side menus such as dumplings and pork cutlet are also served, and the inside of the store is clean and spacious, and there is a waiting area along with friendly service.

voyage.name: Honam Haemultang
voyage.content: This is a seafood restaurant that many locals visit.

voyage.name: Jjajang and Udong
voyage.content: This is a Chinese restaurant that makes its own noodles every morning. Its attractions are sweet and sour pork and kkangpunggi, which are fried on the fly, and it is cooked by a Chinese master with more than 40 years of experience.

voyage.name: Tuna Ga
voyage.content: Located near Suraksan Station, the tuna restaurant serves a wide variety of tuna sections and is gaining popularity for its fresh ingredients and cost-effective unlimited refill menu. Inside the store, there is a neat and private room, perfect for group gatherings or special occasions.

voyage.name: Hongga's Braised pollack
voyage.content: This store specializes in pollack soup and pollack intestine soup, and the broth is cool and rich in ingredients, making it perfect for hangovers. The side dishes are seasoned appropriately to suit your taste, and additional hand-made sujebi is served for you to enjoy more deliciously. It is recommended as a menu that makes you especially crave soup on rainy days.

voyage.name: Tteoksan
voyage.content: A snack bar specializing in Busan-style garaetteok tteokbokki, it features thick seasoning and chewy garaetteok cooked in a cauldron. It can be taken out and delivered, and it is perfect for enjoying a light meal with a variety of fried foods and sundae menus. With friendly service, it has good access to public transportation, and it is a recommended restaurant on many blogs.

voyage.name: Migak
voyage.content: This store is a malatang and shabu-shabu restaurant that reproduces the local taste of China, offering generous portions at an affordable price, and boasting a spacious and pleasant atmosphere with a multi-layered structure. With a variety of menus, it is a perfect place for dinners and gatherings.

voyage.name: Original Dukkeobi House Fire Ojingeo
voyage.content: Operated since 1978, it features an instant stir-fry of fresh squid and vegetables. The spicy taste is controllable, and fried rice is recommended as a must-have. It is famous for its fast turnaround and friendly service.

voyage.name: Arslonga Yeonsinnae
voyage.content: It is a restaurant that offers an atmosphere suitable for celebrating a special day and a variety of menus. It offers lettering pizza and mega-birthday wine optimized for birthdays and anniversaries, with cozy lighting and relaxed seating arrangements for a private meal. In addition, it can be accompanied by a dog, which can accommodate a wide range of customers.

voyage.name: illo
voyage.content: Located in Yinsinnae, Izakaya offers a variety of sashimi, nabe, and grilled dishes, and is loved by many customers for its cozy atmosphere and friendly service. Cabbage salad and white kimchi served as basic side dishes are especially impressive, and they are popular enough to have wait.

voyage.name: Kkulsodam
voyage.content: They sell a wide variety of desserts as well as delicious drinks. In addition, there is a cooking class.

voyage.name: Saetbeol Bakery
voyage.content: The cafe sells various desserts. Dacuaz is the most popular dessert in this cafe. Prices vary from time to time.

voyage.name: Onion Mia
voyage.content: It is a type of cafe that cannot be seen abroad. Furniture arrangement and lighting are very interesting and emotional.

voyage.name: CafeBanghak
voyage.content: It is a very quiet cafe next to Banghakcheon. Also, the space is small and comfortable.

voyage.name: Saamann Coffee Roasters
voyage.content: If it is a small cafe in Seongbuk-dong, you can enjoy a good atmosphere and coffee with various beans

voyage.name: magamil
voyage.content: It's a small cafe, and you can drink coffee and eat Furutz Sando, the signature of this cafe.

voyage.name: komu
voyage.content: It is a small cafe in Seongbukcheon Stream where you can drink coffee and eat banana pudding. You can also take a walk in Seongbukcheon Stream nearby.

voyage.name: Natadenata
voyage.content: It is an egg tart restaurant made by Portuguese locals. There is a lot of waiting, so it may be sold out early.

voyage.name: Mongsangga Crepe
voyage.content: It is a dessert specialty store that offers a variety of crepe menus using fresh seasonal fruits. With a compact and cozy atmosphere, the store is located in a residential alley with a quiet dessert experience. All crepes basically include milk whipped cream, Nutella, and crunchy toppings.

voyage.name: Café Vibe
voyage.content: It is a place to enjoy with a dog, and provides a spacious and pleasant environment. It offers a variety of drinks and desserts, especially baked sweet potatoes and salt bread. The inside of the cafe has a neat and cozy atmosphere, providing a comfortable rest area for customers.

voyage.name: Dessert Yam Macaroon
voyage.content: Dessert Yam is a macaron specialty store that offers macarons in various flavors and character designs. There are special flavors such as salt vanilla, yellow cheese, and choco Nutella, and there are also Pokémon and Sanrio macarons, which are great for children to enjoy. They are also popular as gifts due to their reasonable price and friendly service.

voyage.name: The Whole Bean
voyage.content: As a cafe that offers handmade desserts and a variety of drinks, it features a cozy and neat white-tone interior. It is popular with many visitors as it offers high-quality desserts at reasonable prices. Specifically, watermelon juice and teddy bear madeleine are mentioned as the recommended menu, and they are conveniently located to enjoy various desserts and drinks.

voyage.name: Hip Duck Coffee
voyage.content: This is a cafe located in Banghak-dong, which means people wait in line and eat.

voyage.name: C_Ke
voyage.content: The handmade cake shop in Yinnae offers a variety of cakes throughout the season, and cakes using fresh fruits are especially popular. The interior of the store has a cozy and warm atmosphere, making it suitable for quietly enjoying dessert. In addition, it has a takeout service and pre-ordering, making it a perfect choice for anniversaries or special occasions.

voyage.name: Flup Coffee
voyage.content: It is a space where you can concentrate in a quiet atmosphere, and it features a modern interior with a combination of midnight blue and white. There is a rooftop, so you can spend a leisurely time while enjoying the mountain view, and it provides a variety of coffee and desserts to satisfy visitors. In particular, the signature menu, custard millefeuille, is a combination of crispy pastry and soft custard, and desse

voyage.name: Cheese Dang
voyage.content: This is a takeout store specializing in castella located in Yinnae, offering a wide variety of castella and whipped cream. Castella is soft and moist, and the store is compact and neat. There is a waiting area, and customers can enjoy the different whipped cream to their personal preferences.

voyage.name: TheSeol
voyage.content: It is a handmade patbingsu restaurant made using 100% domestic red beans from Jirisan Mountain, featuring a combination of soft milk ice and savory red beans. The store is spacious and comfortable, making it easy to visit with friends and family, and offers a simple ordering system through a kiosk and a variety of drinks and desserts.

voyage.name: Monodono
voyage.content: It provides a comfortable and enjoyable time for visitors with its cute interior and various dessert menus. In particular, there are many cute themed menus such as Hello Kitty Desserts, making it a perfect place for gatherings with family visitors or friends. In addition, it offers a wide range of drinks and desserts, adding to the fun of viewing as there is a space for selling props.

voyage.name: 1943 Suyu
voyage.content: This is a hot bar for young people in Korea these days. It is a bar run by YouTubers and has a luxurious interior environment.However, Anju is cheap, so you can feel a good atmosphere in the pub at a low price.

voyage.name: Osulcha Suyu station branch
voyage.content: It is a place where you can drink alone and have a cheap snack.

voyage.name: Hanas
voyage.content: This bar is the Isakaya House. Anju sells Japanese-inspired snacks such as Sashimi and Denpura.

voyage.name: Craft Hans
voyage.content: This is a bar which is located in Junggye-dong. You can enjoy various sort of beer like German draft beer or Czchia craft beer. You can eat food like fried chicken or Italian pizza as well.

voyage.name: Season Nowon
voyage.content: Japanese izakaya gaze is located around Nowon Station, where many restaurants and bars are gathered. You can enjoy raw fish such as flatfish and yellowtail sashimi, as well as fresh flatfish and yellowtail sashimi. In addition to raw fish, beef sukiyagi, fish cake soup, and spicy seafood noodle soup are also prepared. It has a good atmosphere and sells a variety of alcohol. I highly recommend it.

voyage.name: Whales pub
voyage.content: The pub in Wales is located on the street of a hot spot in Gongneung-dong called Gongtral Park and Gongridan-gil. It sells more than 100 kinds of cocktails, high balls, whiskey, and wine, so you can enjoy a variety of liquor. The Gambas is especially delicious. voyage.content: It sells a variety of snacks and drinks.

voyage.name: Anto
voyage.content: Guests can use free fitness, sauna, swimming pool, and outdoor bath.
